subject: Axon Labs service surge: SLO impact, proposed commercial makewhole & approvals
messages:
From: Sara Green <sara.green@axonlabs.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
Cc: Tom Ellis <tom.ellis@axonlabs.com>
Date: Fri, 28 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Production latency & 5xx spike — environment AXN-PROD

Ben —

We saw a large throughput collapse and sustained 5xx spikes across our production cluster starting ~08:35 PDT this morning. Impact: our customer-facing batch jobs timed out and the web UI experienced intermittent errors for ~45 minutes. We've attached a short log extract and a latency heatmap.

High-level numbers from our telemetry:
- Error rate: baseline 0.3% -> peak 7.8% (08:35–09:20)
- Tail latency (p99): baseline ~450ms -> peak ~4.6s
- Request throughput: dropped ~62% during the period

This is material for our SLOs and our internal execs are asking for an explanation and proposed remediation, including commercial makewhole. Please advise next steps and who from your side can lead the postmortem and credit conversation.

Thanks,
Sara Green
Director, Integrations — Axon Labs
Attachments: support_log_0828.txt (text), latency_heatmap_0828.png (image)
From: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
To: Sara Green <sara.green@axonlabs.com>
Cc: Tom Ellis <tom.ellis@axonlabs.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 28 Aug 2026 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Production latency & 5xx spike — environment AXN-PROD

Sara — thanks for the quick heads up and the artifacts. We see the same signal on our side. Immediate notes:

- I am owning the coordination. Marcus is already investigating the kernel-level scheduler / batching anomalies that look correlated.
- We should get an exec sync on Monday (30 Aug) with Axon and Redwood leadership; propose 10:00 PDT.
- For the customer-facing ask: we'll come back with a proposed credit calculation and a remediation timeline by EOB Monday.

Short-term mitigation steps in flight:
1) Route traffic away from the affected pool (in progress).
2) Temporarily relax batching heuristics for your tenant to reduce queueing latency (Marcus).
3) Capture full trace set and retaining 72 hours of raw traces for your audit (Monica will enable).

CC’ing Vivek and Laura for commercial/legal runway.

Ben
Ben Carter | Account Director, Strategic Accounts | Redwood Inference
From: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, Sara Green <sara.green@axonlabs.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 28 Aug 2026 11:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Production latency & 5xx spike — environment AXN-PROD

Folks — quick technical summary from the initial debug:

- Root cause (prelim): a sudden shift in sequence-length distribution + a rare interaction between our dynamic batching window and an unbalanced worker pool. That created long tail amplification (queue head-of-line blocking) for Axon's long-context requests.
- Evidence: correlated CPU saturation on GPU-0 of pool-3 and KV cache misses for ~08:34–09:17. See attached support_log_0828.txt for sampling.
- Immediate fix applied at 09:05: redistributed traffic and pinned Axon to a lower-batch path; p99 returned to ~480ms by 09:22.

Next steps for technical remediation:
- Marcus: build a per-tenant override to disable automatic batch fusion for high-variance sequence patterns (ETA 72 hours).
- Monica: export all request traces + KV cache metrics to your S3 for forensics.

I will include the exact trace IDs in the postmortem.

— Marcus
Senior SRE, Redwood Inference
From: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 29 Aug 2026 08:22:00 -0700
Subject: Internal: Axon Labs — proposed credit + contract amendment for exec review

Team —

Summary: Axon suffered a 45-minute incident on 8/28 with sustained p99 degradation and elevated error rate. Marcus confirmed mitigation; customer requests a commercial remedy and wants leadership-level clarity. I need approvals below to finalize an offer to send to Axon Monday before the exec call.

Proposed commercial terms (draft):
- Makewhole: credit equal to 25% of August monthly usage bill, capped at $75k, OR a service credit computed as 1.5x the estimated incremental cost of impacted tokens (whichever is higher).
- Contract amendment: include a clause that clarifies "surge-triggered remediation" timelines and binds a 30-day remediation window for kernel/batching fixes when Redwood code causes SLO regressions.
- SLO validation: Redwood will deliver a postmortem + remediation plan within 5 business days; include agreed test prompts / evals that Axon can run to validate fix.

Approvals needed:
- Vivek: commercial ok for up to $75k cap?
- Laura: legal signoff on amendment wording & expedited DocuSign route?
- Evelyn: CS acceptance that this is sufficient (and whether credits should be applied as billing credit or account-level service credit).

Attachments/links: Axon MPA signed (present in their contract folder) + HubSpot deal AXN-2025-PLG-0042.

Ben

Date: Mon, 30 Aug 2026 16:04:00 -0700
Subject: Next steps & commercial offer — Axon Labs production incident (8/28)

Sara / Tom —

Thanks again for raising the incident and for the logs. Quick update and next steps following our internal approvals:

1) Technical: Marcus and Monica delivered trace exports and a short-term per-tenant override is live. Marcus will deliver a code-backed fix for batching behavior in ~72 hours and a gated rollout plan thereafter.

2) Commercial offer (draft):
- Redwood will apply a billing credit equal to 25% of Axon's August usage invoice, capped at $75,000.
- If Axon prefers a different construct, we can compute a token-based credit at 1.5x the estimated incremental cost; please indicate preference.

3) Contract amendment: Laura has drafted a short addendum clarifying surge-triggered remediation timelines; we'll route via DocuSign for countersignature. Link: https://docusign.net/embeddedSigning/txn/AXN-CREDIT-2026

4) Exec sync: Proposed Monday 30 Aug 10:00 PDT — please confirm availability. Call will include Tom Ellis (Axon CTO), Sara, Vivek, Evelyn, Laura, Marcus.

If you accept the offer, I'll start the DocuSign flow this afternoon and coordinate billing once countersigned.

Forwarded for context: earlier debug notes and Marcus' sampling.

— Ben
